name: Fly Bar

hours.Friday: Open until 2:00 AM (site states 'Open Everyday to 2 am')

access.summary: N Judah to Duboce/Fillmore, then 24 Divisadero
access.detail: From 21st Ave & Judah take the N Judah inbound to Duboce & Fillmore, then transfer to the 24 Divisadero northbound and exit at Divisadero & Fulton; 762 Divisadero is a short walk. The 5 Fulton along Fulton Street is an alternate. Roughly 35-40 minutes.

source.label: Official Fly Bar site
source.quote: 762 Divisadero St, San Francisco, CA 94117 — HOURS: Open Everyday to 2 am. Menu block: Mon-Thurs: 2 pm - 2 am / Sat: 12 pm - 2 am / Sun: 10 am - 2 am

flags: Irregularity for review: the official site gives a blanket 'Open Everyday to 2 am' plus a menu-hours block that lists Mon-Thurs, Sat and Sun but omits a separate Friday opening time. The 2 AM close is stated for every day; the Friday opening hour is not published.

verification.method: Official venue site checked on 2026-09-06 for address and hours; the 2 AM daily close is explicit, but the Friday opening time is missing from the published block and is flagged rather than guessed.
